question: In the post-independence period, who won the 1st individual Olympic Medal for India in 1952?
solution:
The correct answer is __Khashaba Jadhav__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **K.D. Jadhav:-**

 
 
• **He was an Indian freestyle wrestler.**
 
• He was born on January 15, 1926, in Goleshwar, Maharashtra, India, and died on August 14, 1984, in Kolhapur, Maharashtra, India.
 
• **Jadhav is best known for winning a bronze medal at the 1952 Summer Olympics in Helsinki, Finland. He was the first athlete from independent India to win an individual medal in the Olympics. **
 
• At the 1952 Olympics, Jadhav competed in the flyweight division (up to 52 kilograms).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Milkha Singh:-**

 
 
• **He was an Indian track and field sprinter. He was one of the most successful athletes in Indian history.**
 
• He won numerous medals at the Asian Games and Commonwealth Games, and narrowly missing out on a medal at the Olympics.
 
 
 
• **Kapil Dev Ramlal Nikhanj:-**
 
 
• **He is a former Indian cricketer. **
 
• One of the greatest all-rounders in the history of cricket, he was a fast-medium bowler and a hard-hitting middle-order batsman.
 
• Dev is the only player in the history of cricket to have taken more than 400 wickets (434 wickets) and scored more than 5,000 runs in Test cricket.
 
 
 
• **Karnam Malleswari:-**
 
 
• **She is a retired Indian weightlifter. **
 
• She is the first Indian woman to win a medal at the Olympics, a bronze in the 69 kg category at the 2000 Summer Olympics in Sydney.
